name: addrparse
algorithm: n splitmix64 addresses (half IPv4, half IPv6 with zero runs), each formatted as ip:port text with the std facility into a reused buffer and parsed back with the std parser; sum over the parsed port and address bytes, wrapping (README.md).
notes: Measures std.net's ParseAddr and Addr's Format (std-net2 audit rows) against Go netip, Rust std::net and C inet_ntop/inet_pton.
C has no ip:port facility: inet_ntop and inet_pton do the addresses, hand loops the brackets and the port.
Zig 0.17: std.Io.net.IpAddress.format into a fixed std.Io.Writer, IpAddress.parseLiteral; its checksum agreed with the others (zig build-exe -O ReleaseFast -mcpu=x86_64_v2, std-net2 session 1).
